A5092264566.title: Media presentations of Vietnam's cybersecurity law: A comparative approach with corpus-based critical discourse analysis

By Applying System Justification Theory (Sjt) and Positioning Theory (Pt), the Study Explores How State Media Exploit Cognitive Motives for System Justification by Portraying Powerless Laypeople (Sense of Powerlessness) Amidst Cyber Threats and Hostile Acts of Reactionary Forces (Political Alienation) in Contrast to the Powerful Leadership of the Party-State (Political Allegiance). The Study Also Examines How Political Leaders Invoke the Need for Closure/Orientation by Assigning Rights and Obligations to Involved Parties.
